fields.System.Title: RET-202 — Blind return with approval
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a returns clerk, I want to receive goods that arrived with no RMA, so that parcels
customers sent without authorisation can still be processed.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given no RMA reference, then I can start a blind return recording customer, products,
  • and quantities.
  • - Given a blind return, then supervisor approval is required before confirmation.
  • - Given the system finds a plausible matching order, then it offers the match.
  • - Given an order shipped before go-live and therefore unfindable, then the return can
  • still be processed with an exception record.
  • - Given any blind return, then the stock lands in quarantine — there is no exception.
  • - Given blind returns, then their volume is reportable, since a high rate means the RMA
  • process is being bypassed.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | returns, inventory |
| Tables | return_receipt, return_line |
| Risks | Original order not found ([doc 05 WF 9](../../../docs/05-workflows.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
